__README__: SERVER-SIDE TEAM RULES for PollSlide workspaces.
These run on Firebase's servers, so seat limits and roles cannot be bypassed by
a tampered client. MERGE the 'workspaces' and 'team_invites' blocks below into your
EXISTING Realtime Database rules — do NOT paste this file as your whole ruleset, or
you'll lock out sessions/quiz_builder/users.
HOW TO APPLY:
1. Firebase Console -> Realtime Database -> Rules.
2. Add the 'workspaces' and 'team_invites' keys inside your top-level 'rules' object.
3. Use the Rules Playground (Simulator) to test: a 6th member write to a 5-seat
workspace must be DENIED; owner/admin writes ALLOWED; member self-join ALLOWED.
4. Publish.
WHAT IT ENFORCES:
- Role-gated writes: only the owner or an admin can add/remove others or manage invites.
- Read access limited to the workspace owner and its members.
SEAT CAP is enforced SERVER-SIDE in api/team.js (the Admin SDK can count members;
RTDB rules CANNOT count children — numChildren() is not a Rules method). Since the
client routes every team mutation through /api/team, the 5/25 cap holds there.
KNOWN LIMITATION: the self-join clause ($uid === auth.uid) lets a signed-in user add
themselves (needed only as a fallback before api/team.js is deployed). Once the API is
live, remove that clause so only owners/admins can write members — acceptance then goes
through the API (Admin SDK, which bypasses these rules anyway).
SHARE LINKS (PresentSlide): merge the 'sharedDecks' block too. A share id is
unguessable (random); anyone WITH THE LINK can read that one deck; only the
signed-in owner can create or overwrite their own share.

$wsId..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid) || data.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid)
